_note: boards.json recorded this row `drift-coach-never-mounts`. That was true and
it now has a cause and a fix, found by driving the demo rather than reading
the JSX: `RailCoach` renders only when `completedCount === 0`, and the
editor's OWN bootstrap page ticked 'Add your first page' on first paint —
`useComposerInit` calls `elements.createPage` when storage is empty, which
emits `project:changed { type: page:created }` outside any import, and
`OnboardingMount` credited it. Measured at localhost:5050: 1/7 done and an
achievement overlay on screen four seconds after boot, untouched. The credit
now requires MORE THAN ONE page — the same rule the catch-up seeding beside
it already used. Re-measured: 0/7 done and the coach on the rail. This
recipe then DISMISSES it with the button, which is the state the board draws.
So the surface is reached the way a first-run user reaches it: boot, the
coach appears, press Got it, the drawer closes. No probe.
